1949, October
RETREAT Tuesday - ALL SAINTS
II TONGUE, SINS AND DANGERS of ....
III. POVERTY.
Outstanding feature of everything really Franciscan. Gospel Poverty and Gospel perfection "Go sell what thou hast and. give to the poor and come follow me, and thou shalt have treasures in heaven." IF THOU WILT BE PERFECT.
WEDNESDAY - ALL SOULS
I. PRIDE.
In Heaven as well as on earth pride proceeds all other sins ... in malevolence as well as in actual commission.
II. For the Lay Brothers Only.
III. HOLY SACRAMENT OF PENANCE, GREAT SOURCE OF JOY AS WELL AS OF PEACE.
IV. GENEROSITY, HEROISM what Jesus seeks.
I. Gospel TIDINGS - GOOD, JOYFUL tidings.
III. DEVOTION TO OUR BLESSED MOTHER MARY.
. . Monstra te esse Matrem . .
""In order to arrive at having pleasure in everything, desire to have pleasure in nothing.
In order to arrive at possessing everything, Desire to possess nothing.
In order to arrive at being everything, Desire to be nothing. In order to arrive at knowing everything, Desire to know nothing." St. John of the Cross.
END OF RETREAT NOTES Oct. 30 - Nov. 2, 1949
